reviews.text: Best resource for quitting drinking. I suffered with severe alcoholism for almost a decade and found this app the 2nd time I tried to quit. I love that it does so much more than just track your sobriety count. It gives you information on ways your body and health is healing every day you’re alcohol free. It gives you a section to journal, track cravings, calming exercises, and even a great social community to post and interact with people who are going through the same thing as you. I feel really grateful to have found this app!

Best app for quit drinking. I love this app has everything you need all the tools and resources top notch app. You guys gave me resources for free. Love that it’s a free app to track your progress. Haven’t seen an app as good as this one. Usually don’t reviews on apps but this app was so good I just had to!

Enjoyable. I really like this app , it offer support and also offers a cut down limit , not just a fully quit . It quite easy to use and I like it marks every second you don’t drink . I would give this a 5 stars for how easy it is to use and how much I enjoy it .
Amazing!. Best app for no drinking I have ever seen by far!

simple and fair. without pay, the app does what you would expect it to do, count the time of your sobriety.

surprisingly this is a mot more than what other apps of the same nature will do without pay. 
there’s a couple more features that could probably help those who want more stats and encouragement to keep going. i don’t know much about those features since i just wanted the basic timer

Best app out there. This app offers so much, if you’re ready to start your journey to sobriety, this app will make it so much easier on you. So grateful that I found it.

My app is my guide. I can’t believe how doing nothing more than working with an app could help me control my desire for alcohol. I’m taking the money I save and putting it in a savings account. And every day that I look at it I feel that the app is giving me an AttaGirl!

Great way to break the bad habit. When you start to quit, you’re trying to overcome the urges and the associated dopamine hit that comes with it.

This app makes you look forward to the next goal. 15 minutes after quitting and you’re already getting benefits of stopping. 

Great app! Would love more quitting apps like this one!

Remember your Core value. Remembering why you started in the first place and it’s your life. You don’t get a second chance if you drink again..you can live the better, healthier version. Amazing app. It has a Facebook type of feel accept this is allot more positive and healthy then Facebook. Great place for support and encouragement.

Life changer. This app has been a great tool for me. It’s helped me change the trajectory of my life. The tracker and community have helped me significantly. Thanks to the developers for making such a great app!

Peter gehdu. 5th day no alcohol. Something like this, makes all the difference.
Great ap!. Great ap, very simple to use & very encouraging!

Great app for quitting!. I have been looking for an app similar to the NHS’ QuitSmoking App. I found the NHS app’s health stats super motivational on my quit journey. For example, Day 2- your skin blah blah. 

On the Quit Drinking app it has all of that and more! Gives you your predicted Liver, heart and mind health status. The community and buddy feature is incredibly helpful. It has a fully working social media app vibe within the app as well as really helpful tips and meditations. 

The UI and design could be better. Writing comments or posts is awkward, esp if you need to go back and edit. The screen doesn’t catch up with your typing so you can’t see what you’ve typed or deleted. There is an option to share your Instagram account, but the feature doesn’t work properly and links to an ‘unknown’ instagram profile. 

For people like me with Autism, the colours could be less jarring and the visible text and font formatable. Apart from that - all good.

No support. So it’s a good app in general and most people there are helpful. It has many good points but a huge reason I didn’t give it five stars is because there is no support. It says contact and you email and it comes back saying that email is deleted. So yeh, if you need support as in if trouble from another member etc, you are out of luck.

Breaking a habit.. I now live on my own and had falling into a habit of drinking every night, this has been going on for a couple of years now . I don’t class myself as alcoholic but I wanted a break from the booze.
 I found this simple app to give me some encouragement and it is working great for me.
 I don’t intend to give up drinking forever but with the help of this app I think it’s possible.
Predatory.. They ask for a large sum of money after learning that you may be at rock bottom. They don’t want to help, they want to prey on us.

There is no free version. They need to be upfront before you answer personal questions. They should just say upfront the cost. There is no free version. And a free trial that comes with automatic payment afterwards of just a few days is a trick

Daniel swan. Love this app !
A+ for everything !

Btw, I’m not paying anything for the use of the app. There is a section where you opt to pay but in my case I’m happy with the free version. Maybe in the future I’ll join.

Great app but…. There doesn’t appear to be a moderator. Problem is the odd knucklehead member that thinks it’s ok to the arbiter of censorship and create bad energy in the app. These tool bags need to be kicked off as they follow the posts like a bad smell. They crave attention and don’t care about the community if it means targeting individuals. Reporting seems to do nothing. Where is the moderator?? Shame. Hence why the loss of a star. 

Other than that, a great app if you want a close community that (for the most part) supports you.
